summary: Nomura Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its monthly share buyback for May 2026. Under a board resolution from January 30, 2026, it has authorized repurchase of up to 100 million shares for up to JPY 60 billion through September 30, 2026. During May, it continued repurchasing, bringing cumulative repurchases to 46.86 million shares for JPY 59.999 billion (100% of the monetary limit, 46.9% of shares). No disposition or cancellation of shares was reported in the month. This is a routine open-market buyback program. Nomura is the issuer. The filing reflects ongoing capital return to shareholders. Watch for utilization of remaining share authorization and any updates on cancellation plans.
